title: Invoke step
description: Transfers control to a resource: what to call, what to pass it, whether to call it, and how to re-attempt it.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Values passed to the invoked resource. Omitted, it sends `{}`.

when.title: When
when.description: CEL guard — the dispatch is skipped when it evaluates false.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: How long ONE attempt may take — a positive duration (`500ms`, `30s`) or an integer number of milliseconds; on elapse the dispatch is cancelled and the step fails ERR_STEP_TIMEOUT. Per attempt rather than for the whole retry loop, so what a single call is allowed to take does not depend on how slow the earlier attempts were. It belongs to the step rather than the target because the target does not know who is waiting.
